At a farbrengen on Shabbos Parshas Va'eira, 3 Shevat 1970, the Rebbe announced the completion of the Sefer Torah in the coming days.
section.t: At the farbrengen of Shabbos Parshas Va'eira,
5730 (1970), the Rebbe shlita announced its completion in the coming days.
And this is the text of the sicha said at the time of its completion:

section.sectionSummaryBrief: It was desired that the completion of the Sefer Torah, which the Rebbe's father-in-law began writing, should coincide with the end of the twenty-year period since his passing.
section.t: that the completion of the Sefer Torah, which my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, began writing, should be at the conclusion of the twenty-year period since his passing.
